prompt:
ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical outside faces.

Create an ORIGINAL game sprite part: a compact reverse-osmosis water treatment unit, seen from directly above, as it sits bolted to the deck of a water tanker. Image 1 is our approved hose reel on a tanker's deck, seen from above: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Image 2 is our approved water bowser trailer seen from above, for style and scale only: do not draw the trailer.

Draw ONLY the treatment unit, alone and centred on a plain pure white background. It is a rectangle about twice as long as it is wide, running top to bottom, filling about 75 percent of the canvas height: a light grey steel equipment cabinet with a louvred vent panel on its lid and two small hinges along one edge; beside it, on the same frame, two long white cylindrical membrane pressure housings lying side by side, each with a dark rounded end cap at both ends; a few short pale blue pipes joining the housings to the cabinet; a small dark electric pump motor at one end.

Style: a top-down sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No trailer, tank, truck, deck, people, text, letters, numbers, logos, gauges, dials, water, shadow outside the object, perspective or tilt.

prompt:
GAME ITEM ICON. Camera above the object looking down at about sixty degrees, the way the game RimWorld draws loose items on the floor. One tidy object, centred.

Create an ORIGINAL game item sprite for the D'thorga membrane cartridge: a replacement filter element for a reverse-osmosis water purifier. Image 1 is our approved tyre set and image 2 our approved drive belt, from the same family: match their outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy their shapes.

Draw ONLY the cartridge, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about 75 percent of the canvas. Square canvas.

A long white cylindrical filter cartridge lying on its side, wrapped in a pale translucent outer layer with a few thin bands around it, a dark grey moulded end cap at each end, and a short pale blue pipe stub sticking out of the centre of the nearer end cap.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art. It must read clearly when shrunk to 64 pixels: one big shape, few small ones.

No people, hands, animals, vehicles, text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, water, dust, floor, ground or cast shadow.
